topics.title: Five Research Agents, Four Hours, One Business Plan
topics.pitch: 5 parallel agents, 5 research tracks, one business plan in under 4 hours. Key finding: zero subscription maintenance companies in Greece (white space). Counterintuitive beachhead: non-resident Airbnb hosts + Golden Visa expats, NOT mass Greek market. How agent-speed research finds what sequential research misses.

topics.title: The Credentials We Almost Shipped
topics.pitch: Security audit flagged CRITICAL: Discord credential JSONs in a git-tracked workspace with 644 permissions. Not just a mistake — a pattern. Agent infrastructure creates credential exposure paths that don't exist in traditional software.

topics.title: 62 RSVPs Before We Knew What Hit Us
topics.pitch: Athens AI meetup: 20-RSVP target hit by morning. Then 3x by evening — a single hour drove +15 RSVPs. What a spontaneous spike tells you about building in public in a market nobody else has touched.

topics.title: Writing for Humans When Your AI Does the Writing
topics.pitch: R flagged Day 6 as too long. Built content standards: 800-word limit, 6-point scan test. Core insight: your AI reads anything in seconds. Your human reader scans for 8 seconds and clicks away.

topics.title: Every Project Was Blocked and That Was Useful
topics.pitch: 5 projects active, 3 blocked on tiny things. Status review turned 'everything is slow' into a dependency map. A blocked project isn't failure — it's a map.

topics.title: You Will Be Attacked Before You're Ready
topics.pitch: Email injection on Day 1 of having an inbox. Claimed to be admin, asked for tools summary. What it looked like, how it was caught, why email is the highest-risk channel for agents.
